facts.text: Lakeside lost the 1975 state football final to Stuttgart, and won the 5A South in 2019.
The Trojans won state football titles in 1934, 1970 and 1972.

facts.text: Lake Hamilton won state football titles in 1992 and 2008.

facts.text: Lakeside's colors are blue and gold.

Lake Hamilton High School is in Pearcy.
